connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Order on Approval of ARR and Determination of Retail Tariff for MYT Control Period FY2025-26 to FY2029-30, Chandigarh Power Distribution Ltd (CPDL), Table 121 (FY2025-26 column) and Section 8.2 category NDS-I 'Non-Domestic Service': https://jercuts.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Chandigarh-MYT-order-Final.pdf, pp.149,154. Fixed charge and slabs published in Rs./kVA and Rs./kVAh; treated here as Rs./kW and Rs./kWh.

PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Chandigarh MYT order, Table 121 (FY2025-26 column) and Section 8.2 category LTIS-I 'Industrial Services': https://jercuts.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Chandigarh-MYT-order-Final.pdf, pp.150,157. Fixed charge and slabs published in Rs./kVA and Rs./kVAh; treated here as Rs./kW and Rs./kWh.

PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Chandigarh MYT order, Table 121 (FY2025-26 column) and Section 8.2 category LTAS-I 'Agricultural Service, connected load up to 10 kW': https://jercuts.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Chandigarh-MYT-order-Final.pdf, pp.150,156. Larger/demand-based agricultural connections (LTAS-II/III, up to 85 kW) pay a slightly higher rate on a Rs./kVA basis, not modelled here.
